LibreChat ships GOOGLE_KEY=user_provided (.env.example:532), google in defaultEndpoints (packages/data-provider/src/config.ts:3346), and the Gemini image tool. Vertex service-account routing is a separate configured provider. The owner excludes Runhuman 1; Inbox Zero and Ponder are absent from the scanned demand. No demanded runtime caller uses embeddings, uploads/files, caches, model listing, token counting, tuning, dynamic methods or live sockets.
